display.purpose: Page-level h1s only. Editorial weight, slight negative tracking.

title.purpose: Card-level h2s. Same family as display, smaller.

body.purpose: Default body text, table rows, descriptions. cv11 + ss01 features for clarity.

body-small.purpose: Helper text, table headers, metadata. Always at least neutral-500 for AA contrast.

label.purpose: Form field labels via the .label class. Uppercase, tracked, weight 700.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Page-level .card surfaces. Double layer (1px ambient + 8px diffuse) reads as 'container' without registering as 'drop shadow'.

shadows.name: subtle
shadows.purpose: TodayStrip. Lighter than card so the hierarchy reads.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Native <dialog> elements when open. The only shadow that explicitly announces elevation.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Standard ease for all state transitions. Exponential decay, no bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: page-fade
motion.purpose: PageTransition fade-in on client navigation. 0 opacity + 3px translate to 1 opacity + 0 translate.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: Dialog open: opacity 0 + 6px translate + 2% scale-down to opacity 1 + 0 + 1.

motion.name: celebrate-banner
motion.purpose: Approval banner slide-in from above. Only celebratory motion that survived /impeccable quieter.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Routine administrative action (Sign in, Save, Add holiday, Send invite). Ink black over warm paper.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; gap: 6px; background: #0a0a0a; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #262626; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a0a0a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #d4d4d4; color: #737373; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The lime promise. Used only on the four leave-creating CTAs (Request leave, Submit request, Log leave, Approve) and the approval banner.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; gap: 6px; background: #D7FF36; color: #0a0a0a; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a0a0a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-accent:disabled { background: #e5e5e5; color: #737373; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; filter: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tertiary action: dialog cancel buttons, Copy beside invite link.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; gap: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #404040; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #fafafa; border-color: #d4d4d4; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a0a0a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { background: #fafafa; color: #a3a3a3; border-color: #e5e5e5; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirmation: Reject, Cancel request, Delete invite, Remove holiday.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; gap: 6px; background: #e11d48; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #f43f5e; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e11d48; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { background: #fecdd3; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text, email, password, number, select, textarea. Always used inside a <Field> wrapper for label association.

components.name: Card
components.description: Page-level content surface. White over warm paper, rounded-2xl, 1px neutral border, double-layer faint shadow.
components.html:
Who's off

Approved leave across the team this year

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Neutral pill with a colored 6px dot. Pill background never changes; the dot encodes state. Lime = approved, rose = rejected, neutral filled = cancelled, neutral outlined ring = pending.
components.html: approvedrejectedpendingcancelled
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; background: #f5f5f5; color: #262626; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-status--muted { color: #737373; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-dot--lime { background: #D7FF36; } .ds-status-dot--rose { background: #f43f5e; } .ds-status-dot--neutral { background: #a3a3a3; } .ds-status-dot--outline { background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #737373; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Native <dialog> modal opened via showModal(). Focus trap, Esc, aria-modal handled by the platform. Backdrop click closes. Replaces all native alert/confirm/prompt.

narrative.overview: BBM Leave is internal software a small marketing agency opens once or twice a month. Its job is to disappear into the task: book leave in thirty seconds, approve in two clicks, close the tab. The visual system serves that disappearance. Generous space, a single saturated accent (lime) reserved for moments that matter, neutral everything else, no decoration that doesn't earn its place. The system rejects, by name, the things PRODUCT.md rejects: enterprise HR software (BambooHR, Workday, ADP, Personio); the generic Tailwind/shadcn reflex; cheery SaaS templates with pastel cards and gradient hero metrics; brand showcases where decoration obstructs the task. What replaces them: lime and ink over warm paper, an editorial display face on h1/h2 only, Inter for everything else, a 44px touch-target floor on every interactive element, and a single principle: lime is a promise.
keyCharacteristics: One brand color (lime), one negative color (rose), neutral everything else.
Lime occupies less than 10% of any screen.
Sharp craft over chrome: full borders, no side stripes, no glassmorphism beyond a purposeful sticky bar.
Density is restrained. A tool used twice a month should breathe.
Display font on headings only; body, labels, data, and buttons all Inter.

rules.name: The Lime Promise Rule
rules.body: Lime appears only on actions and moments that advance leave: today's date, the four leave-creating CTAs, the approved status dot, and the moment leave is approved. It does not appear on settled administrative state, decorative dividers, hover-only flourishes, or the brand logo.

rules.name: The Two-Track Status Rule
rules.body: Status is communicated on two tracks: a colored dot (lime / rose / neutral; outlined ring for in-process) on top of a uniform neutral pill. The pill is always bg-neutral-100. Color carries state, never the pill. Type discriminators (annual / sick, etc.) live in the text label, never in color.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: #000 and #fff are prohibited as Tailwind shortcuts. Use bg-brand-ink (#0a0a0a) and bg-warm-paper (#fafaf9). White is permitted only as a surface contrast inside cards, inputs, and dialogs over warm paper.

rules.name: The Display-Headings-Only Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque appears on h1 through h6 only. Body, buttons, labels, and data use Inter. Display fonts in UI controls are forbidden.

rules.name: The 65-75ch Rule
rules.body: Body prose caps at 65-75 character width. Data tables may run wider; descriptions in empty states use max-w-sm (~28rem) to keep the read.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: New surfaces ship without shadow. Reach for one of the three named shadows (card, subtle, modal) only when the surface genuinely needs separating from its background. Don't invent a fourth.

rules.name: The No-Side-Stripe Rule
rules.body: A colored border-left or border-right greater than 1px is forbidden as an accent. Use a full hairline border, a background tint, or a leading dot instead.

dos: Do use lime (brand-accent) only on today's date marker, the four leave-creating CTAs (Request leave, Submit request, Log leave for employee, Approve), the approved status dot, and the approval banner. Nowhere else.
Do route every form input through <Field> so htmlFor and aria-describedby are guaranteed.
Do route every confirm / destructive interaction through <Dialog>, never window.confirm/alert/prompt.
Do use bg-brand-ink (#0a0a0a) instead of bg-black, and text-brand-ink instead of text-black. Same for opacity modifiers (bg-brand-ink/10).
Do use text-neutral-500 as the contrast floor for body and meta text. neutral-400 is for genuinely decorative or aria-disabled content only.
Do keep buttons and inputs at the min-h-11 (44px) touch floor. Inherit from .btn and .input; don't override below.
Do give every interactive element a visible focus-visible state (ring or border shift).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion. Every animation listed in globals.css already opts out.
donts: Don't look like enterprise HR software. No corporate blue, no stock photography, no nested tabs, no cluttered chrome. Specifically: not BambooHR, not Workday, not ADP, not Personio.
Don't ship the generic Tailwind / shadcn reflex: gray-on-white, neutral-500 everywhere, rounded-lg shadow-sm on every container.
Don't use slate-* anywhere. The codebase is neutral-* only.
Don't use red-* for danger. Use rose-*.
Don't use pure black (#000) or pure white (#fff). Use brand-ink and white surfaces over warm-paper.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left or border-right > 1px as a colored accent).
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Use solid colors. Emphasis via weight or size.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. The sticky TopBar blur is the only sanctioned use.
Don't ship the hero-metric template. BalanceCards was deliberately refactored away from this pattern.
Don't use emerald, amber, indigo, sky, violet, teal, cyan. The status palette is lime + rose + neutral, period.
Don't use em dashes. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't apply hover effects that stack translate + scale + colored glow. The btn-accent hover is brightness-only by design.
Don't wrap text in <label> siblings to inputs without htmlFor. Always use <Field>.
